S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seabed Material Extraction Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which materials forming, or under, the seabed are removed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solar Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large-scale photovoltaic system (PV system) designed for the supply of merchant power into the electricity grid. They are differentiated from most building-mounted and other decentralised solar power applications because they supply power at the utility level, rather than to a local user or users. The generic expression utility-scale solar is sometimes used to describe this type of project.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Oil Barrier
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of barriers used to prevent the unwanted spread of oil across the sea surface.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Oil Retention (High Pressure Pipe)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pipe with holes from which air blows. When the air bubbles reach the surface they form a barrier which prevents the spread of oil.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Floating Oil Barrier
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A floating tube shaped structure, with a curtain (2 metre) hanging under it, below the surface, which prevents the spread of oil.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Opening Bridge
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of opening structures spanning and providing passage over a gap or barrier, such as a river or roadway.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swing Bridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A movable bridge (or span thereof) which rotates in a horizontal plane about a vertical pivot to allow the passage of vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lifting Bridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A movable bridge (or span thereof) which is capable of being lifted vertically to allow vessels to pass beneath.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bascule Bridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A counterpoise bridge rotated in a vertical plane about an axis at one or both ends.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Drawbridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A general name for bridges of which part or the entire span of the bridge may be raised or drawn aside to allow ships to pass through.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Pile
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of pile, driven into the earth as a foundation or support for a structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stake
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated wood or metal pole embedded in the seabed to serve as a marker or support.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Post
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vertical piece of timber, metal or concrete forced into the earth or seabed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tripodal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A single structure comprising 3 or more piles held together (sections of heavy timber, steel or concrete), and forced into the earth or seabed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Piling
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A number of piles, usually in a straight line, and usually connected or bolted together.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Area of Piles
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A number of piles, usually in a straight line, but not connected by structural members.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pipe
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vertical hollow cylinder of metal, wood, or other material forced into the earth or seabed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mooring Post
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A post where to which something (such as a craft) can be moored.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Pilot Boarding Place
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of pilot boarding method.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boarding by Pilot-Cruising Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Pilot boards from a cruising vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boarding by Helicopter
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Pilot boards by helicopter which comes out from the shore.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pilot Comes Out from Shore
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Pilot embarks from a vessel or disembarks to a vessel which comes out from the shore on request.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Pipeline/Pipe
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of a pipe systems use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Outfall Pipe
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pipe (generally a sewer or drainage pipe) discharging into the sea or a river.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Intake Pipe
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pipe taking water from a river or other body of water, to drive a mill or supply a canal, waterworks, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sewer
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pipe in a sewage system for carrying water or sewage to a disposal area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bubbler System
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A submerged pipe from which warm water bubbles, preventing the surrounding water from freezing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Supply Pipe
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pipe used for transport (supply) of gas or liquid product.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bubble Curtain
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A high pressure sub-surface pipeline (usually on the seafloor) with holes emitting a curtain of air bubbles. Its uses include: the prevention of acoustic transmission through the water; preventing the spread of surface debris or floating liquids; controlling the movement of fish.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Preference
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The selection of a first choice compared to other options.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Primary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The preferred first choice used in normal conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Alternate
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The preferred choice in extraordinary conditions.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Production Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an area set aside for heavy industry.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Quarry
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An open-air excavation for the extraction of stone intended principally for use in construction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mine
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An excavation made in the terrain for the purpose of extracting and/or exploiting natural resources.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stockpile
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A reserve stock of material, equipment or other supplies.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Power Station Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A facility including one or more buildings and equipment used for power generation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refinery Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A facility where petroleum and/or petroleum products are refined.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Timber Yard
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An open tract for the storage of wooden lumber and timbers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Factory Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A group of buildings where goods are manufactured.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tank Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A collection of collocated large-capacity tanks in which petroleum, natural gas, or liquid petrochemicals are stored.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wind Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A collection of wind turbines that are collocated and are organized as a single power generation unit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slag Heap/Spoil Heap
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Hill of refuse from a mine, industrial plant etc. on land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Production Plant
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A plant where production takes place.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solar Farm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large-scale photovoltaic system (PV system) designed for the supply of merchant power into the electricity grid. They are differentiated from most building-mounted and other decentralised solar power applications because they supply power at the utility level, rather than to a local user or users. The generic expression utility-scale solar is sometimes used to describe this type of project.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Pylon
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the pylon based on the service it is supporting.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Power Transmission Pylon/Pole
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pylon or pole that supports one or more power lines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Telephone/Telegraph Pylon/Pole
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pylon or pole that supports one or more communication lines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aerial Cableway Pylon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tower or pylon supporting steel cables which convey cars, buckets, or other suspended carrier units.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bridge Pylon/Tower
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tower and/or pylon from which the deck of a bridge is suspended.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bridge Pier
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pillar or abutment that supports a bridge span.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pipeline Pylon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tower or pylon supporting a suspended pipeline or pipelines.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Radar Station
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of radar station based on the services offered.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radar Surveillance Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar station established for traffic surveillance.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coast Radar Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shore-based station which the mariner can contact by radio to obtain a position.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Radar Transponder Beacon
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of radar transponder beacon based on functionality.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ramark, Radar Beacon Transmitting Continuously
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar marker beacon which continuously transmits a signal appearing as a radial line on a radar screen, the line indicating the direction of the beacon. Ramarks are intended primarily for marine use. The name 'ramark' is derived from the words radar marker.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Racon, Radar Transponder Beacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar beacon which returns a coded signal which provides identification of the beacon, as well as range and bearing. The range and bearing are indicated by the location of the first character received on the radar screen. The name 'racon' is derived from the words radar beacon.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Leading Racon/Radar Transponder Beacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar beacon that may be used (in conjunction with at least one other radar beacon) to indicate a leading line.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Radio Station
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of radio services offered by a radio station.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: A radiobeacon is a radio transmitter which emits a distinctive or characteristic signal on which a bearing may be taken.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radio Direction-Finding Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radio station intended to determine only the direction of other stations by means of transmission from the latter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Differential GNSS
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Differential GNSS is implemented by placing a GNSS monitor receiver at a precisely known location. Instead of computing a navigation fix, the monitor determines the range error to every GNSS satellite it can track. These ranging errors are then transmitted to local users where they are applied as corrections before computing the navigation result.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Toran
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An electronic position fixing system used mainly by aircraft.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chaika
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low frequency electronic position fixing system using pulsed transmissions at 100 Khz.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Radio Telephone Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The equipment needed at one station to carry on two way voice communication by radio waves only.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: AIS Base Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An AIS shore station for use by competent authorities to provide AIS service, manage the data link and enable effective ship to shore / shore to ship transmission of information.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Rescue Station
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of aid station based on life saving equipment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rescue Station with Lifeboat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where equipment for saving life at sea is maintained; the type of lifeboat may vary from fast, long distance boats to inflatable inshore boats.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rescue Station with Rocket
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A life saving station equipped with line-carrying rocket apparatus.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refuge for Shipwrecked Mariners
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Shelter or protection from danger or distress at sea.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refuge for Intertidal Area Walkers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Shelter or protection from danger in areas exposed to extreme and sudden tides or tidal streams.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lifeboat Lying at a Mooring
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where a lifeboat is moored ready for use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aid Radio Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radio station reserved for emergency situations; might also be a public telephone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: First Aid Equipment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where first aid equipment is available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lifebuoy, Ring Buoy, Life Ring, Life Saver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A "kisby ring" or "perry buoy" designed to be thrown to a person in the water, to provide buoyancy and to prevent drowning.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Restricted Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The official legal status of each kind of restricted area defines the kind of restriction(s), for example the restriction for a 'game reserve' may be 'entering prohibited'.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Offshore Safety Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The area around an offshore installation within which vessels are prohibited from entering without permission. Special regulations protect installations within a safety zone and vessels of all nationalities are required to respect the zone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nature Reserve
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tract of land or water managed so as to preserve its flora, fauna, physical features, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bird Sanctuary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where birds are bred and protected.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Game Reserve
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where wild animals or birds hunted for sport or food are kept undisturbed for private use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seal Sanctuary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where seals are protected.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Degaussing Range
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area, usually about two cables diameter, within which ships' magnetic fields may be measured; sensing instruments and cables are installed on the seabed in the range and there are cables leading from the range to a control position ashore.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area controlled by the military in which restrictions may apply.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Historic Wreck Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area around certain wrecks of historical importance to protect the wrecks from unauthorized interference by diving, salvage or deposition (including anchoring).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Navigational Aid Safety Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area around a navigational aid which vessels are prohibited from entering.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Minefield
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area laid and maintained with explosive mines for defence or practice purposes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swimming Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which people may swim and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Waiting Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area reserved for vessels waiting to enter a harbour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Research Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area where marine research takes place.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dredging Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area where dredging is taking place.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fish Sanctuary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where fish (including shellfish and crustaceans) are protected.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ecological Reserve
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tract of land or water managed so as to preserve the relation of plants and living creatures to each other and to their surroundings.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: No Wake Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which a vessels' speed must be reduced in order to reduce the size of the wake it produces.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swinging Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area where vessels turn.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Skiing Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area within which people may water ski and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Environmentally Sensitive Sea Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A generic term which may be used to describe a wide range of areas, considered sensitive for a variety of environmental reasons.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Particularly Sensitive Sea Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area that needs special protection through action by IMO because of its significance for regional ecological, socio-economic or scientific reasons and because it may be vulnerable to damage by international shipping activities.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Disengagement Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area near a fairway where vessels can go to clear the way or make an about turn and possibly return to a waiting area when nautical conditions impose it.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Port Security Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area in which defence, law and treaty enforcement, and counter-terrorism activities that fall within the port and maritime domain apply.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coral Sanctuary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where coral is protected.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recreation Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area within which recreational activities regularly take place and therefore vessel movement may be restricted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ship Pollution Emission Control
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area within which the ship pollution emission is controlled.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Road
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of a road based on size.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Motorway
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A limited access dual carriageway road specially designed for fast long-distance traffic and subject to special regulations concerning its use. It may have more than two lanes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Major Road
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A hard surfaced (metalled) road; a main through route.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Minor Road
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A secondary road for local traffic.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Track/Path
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Track - a rough path or way formed by use. Path - a way or track laid down for walking or made by continual treading.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Major Street
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A main road, in an urban area, for through traffic.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Minor Street
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A secondary road, in an urban area, for local traffic.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Schedule
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The type of schedule, for instance opening, closure, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Normal Operation
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The service, office, is open, fully manned, and operating normally, or the area is accessible as usual.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Closure
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The service, office, or area is closed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unmanned Operation
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The service is available but not manned.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Sea Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an area based on its physical characteristics.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A natural or artificial passage or channel through shoals or steep banks, or across a line of banks lying between two channels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bank
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elevation of the seafloor, at depths generally less than 200 m, but sufficient for safe surface navigation, commonly found on the continental shelf or near an island.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Deep
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: In oceanography, an obsolete term which was generally restricted to depths greater than 6,000 m.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wide indentation in the coastline generally smaller than a gulf and larger than a cove. For the purposes of the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, a bay is a well-marked indentation whose penetration is in such proportion to the width of its mouth as to contain land locked waters and constitute more than a mere curvature of the coast.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Trench
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long, deep, asymmetrical depression with relatively steep sides, that is associated with subduction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Basin
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A depression of the seafloor more or less equidimensional in plan and of variable extent.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mud Flats
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A level tract of land, as the bed of a dry lake or an area frequently uncovered at low tide. Usually in plural.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reef
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shallow elevation composed of consolidated material that may constitute a hazard to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ledge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rocky formation continuous with and fringing the shore.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Canyon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated, narrow, steep-sided depression that generally deepens down-slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Narrows
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A navigable narrow part of a bay, strait, river, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shoal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shallow elevation composed of unconsolidated material that may constitute a hazard to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Knoll
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A distinct elevation with a rounded profile less than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated elevation of varying complexity and size, generally having steep sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seamount
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A distinct generally equidimensional elevation greater than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pinnacle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any high tower or spire-shaped pillar or rock or coral, alone or cresting a summit. It may extend above the surface of the water. It may or may not be a hazard to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Abyssal Plain
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An extensive, flat, gently sloping or nearly level region at abyssal depths.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Plateau
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large, relatively flat elevation that is higher than the surrounding relief with one or more relatively steep sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spur
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A subordinate ridge protruding from a larger feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shelf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The flat or gently sloping region adjacent to a continent or around an island that extends from the low water line to a depth, generally about 200m, where there is a marked increase in downward slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Trough
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long depression generally wide and flat bottomed with symmetrical and parallel sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Saddle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A broad pass or col in a ridge, rise or other elevation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Abyssal Hill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An isolated small elevation on the deep seafloor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Apron
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gently dipping slope, with a smooth surface, commonly found around groups of islands and seamounts.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Archipelagic Apron
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gentle slope with a generally smooth surface of the seafloor, characteristically found around groups of islands or seamounts.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Borderland
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A region adjacent to a continent, normally occupied by or bordering a shelf and sometimes emerging as islands, that is irregular or blocky in plan or profile, with depths well in excess of those typical of a shelf.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Continental Margin
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The zone, generally consisting of shelf, slope and continental rise, separating the continent from the deep seafloor or abyssal plain or plain. Occasionally a trench may be present in place of a continental rise.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Continental Rise
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A gentle slope rising from the oceanic depths towards the foot of a continental slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Escarpment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated, characteristically linear, steep slope separating horizontal or gently sloping areas of the seafloor.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fan
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively smooth, depositional feature continuously deepening away from a sediment source commonly located at the lower termination of a canyon or canyon system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fracture Zone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long narrow zone of irregular topography formed by the movement of tectonic plates associated with an offset of a spreading ridge axis, characterized by steep-sided and/or asymmetrical ridges, troughs or escarpments.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gap
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A narrow break in a ridge, rise or other elevation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Guyot
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A seamount having a comparatively smooth flat top.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: [1] A small isolated elevation, smaller than a mountain. [2] A distinct elevation generally of irregular shape, less than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hole
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A depression of limited extent with all sides rising steeply from a relatively flat bottom.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Levee
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A depositional embankment bordering a canyon, valley or sea channel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Median Valley
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The axial depression of the mid-oceanic ridge system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Moat
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An annular or partially annular depression commonly located at the base of seamounts, islands and other isolated elevations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mountains
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A natural elevation of the earth's surface rising more or less abruptly from the surrounding level, and attaining an altitude which, relatively to adjacent elevations, is impressive or notable.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Peak
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A conical or pointed elevation on a larger feature such as a seamount.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Province
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A geographically distinct region with a number of shared physiographic characteristics that contrast with those in the surrounding areas. This term should be modified with the generic term that best describes the majority of features in the region, for example "Seamount" in Baja California Seamount Province.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rise
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A broad elevation that generally rises gently and smoothly from the surrounding relief.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sea Channel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated, meandering depression, usually occurring on a gently sloping plain or fan.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seamount Chain
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Several seamounts in linear or arcuate alignment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Shelf-Edge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The line along which there is a marked increase in slope at the seaward margin of a shelf.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively shallow barrier between BASINS that may inhibit water movement.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slope
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The sloping region that deepens from a shelf to the point where there is a general decrease in gradient.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Terrace
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A flat or gently sloping region, generally long and narrow, bounded along one edge by a steeper descending slope and along the other by a steeper ascending slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Valley
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An elongated depression that generally widens and deepens down-slope.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Canal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An artificial waterway with no flow, or a controlled flow, used for navigation, or for draining or irrigating land (ditch).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lake
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large body of water entirely surrounded by land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: River
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A relatively large natural stream of water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reach
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A straight section of a river, especially a navigable river between two bends; or an arm of the sea extending into the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Intertidal Cay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low, flat island of sand, coral, etc. awash or submerged at high water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Submarine Volcano
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A seabed volcano, submerged at the chart sounding datum, which may or may not be active.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chute
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An inclined plane, sloping channel, or passage down or through which things may pass.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Backwater/Slough
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A body of water (as an inlet or tributary) that is out of the main current of a larger body.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bend
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A curve or change in direction of a watercourse or river.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Shoreline Construction
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of shoreline construction based on use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Breakwater
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure protecting a shore area, harbour, anchorage, or basin from waves.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Groyne
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low artificial wall-like structure of durable material extending from the land to seaward for a particular purpose, such as to protect the coast or to force a current to scour a channel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mole
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A form of breakwater alongside which vessels may lie on the sheltered side only; in some cases it may lie entirely within an artificial harbour, permitting vessels to lie along both sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pier (Jetty)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A long, narrow structure extending into the water to afford a berthing place for vessels, to serve as a promenade, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Promenade Pier
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pier built only for recreational purposes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure serving as a berthing place for vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Training Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wall or bank, often submerged, built to direct or confine the flow of a river or tidal current, or to promote a scour action.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rip Rap
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A layer of broken rock, cobbles, boulders, or fragments of sufficient size to resist the erosive forces of flowing water and wave action.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Revetment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Facing of stone or other material, either permanent or temporary, placed along the edge of a stream, river or canal to stabilize the bank and to protect it from the erosive action of the stream.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sea Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An embankment or wall for protection against waves or tidal action along a shore or water front.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Landing Steps
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Steps at the shoreline as the connection between land and water on different levels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ramp
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (1) A sloping structure which may include rails that can either be used, as a landing place, at variable water levels, for small vessels, landing ships, or a ferry boat, or for hauling a cradle carrying a vessel. (2) An accumulation of snow that forms an inclined plane between land or land ice elements and sea ice or ice shelf. Also called drift ice foot.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Slipway
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The prepared and usually reinforced inclined surface on which keel- and bilge-blocks are laid for supporting a vessel under construction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fender
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A protective structure designed to cushion the impact of a vessel and prevent damage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Solid Face Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wharf consisting of a solid wall of concrete, masonry, wood etc., such that the water cannot circulate freely under the wharf. The type of construction affects ship-handling; for example, a solid face wharf may give shelter from tidal streams, but under certain circumstances a cushion of water may build up between such a wharf and a ship attempting to berth at it, causing difficulties in ship handling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Open Face Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wharf supported on piles or other structures which allow free circulation of water under the wharf.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Log Ramp
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An inclined plane used to dump logs into the water for transport, or to haul logs out of the water for processing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lock/Guide Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Permanent structure bounding a lock and including guide walls.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Breaker
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An often wedge-like structure used for protecting a bridge pier, dock, facility, etc. from floating ice or other debris.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swimming Facility
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An artificial pool or swimming enclosure, especially one in the open air, which may be constructed of wire mesh or heavy netting supported by cables, buoys or piles, for swimming in.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Intake Structure
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure designed to divert water from a river or channel for the purpose of water supply, hydroelectric power or irrigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Quay
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wharf approximately parallel to the shoreline and accommodating ships on one side only, the other side being attached to the shore. It is usually of solid construction, as contrasted with the open pile construction usually used for piers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tie-Up Wall
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A section of wall designated for tying-up vessels awaiting transit. Bollards and mooring devices are available for both large and small ships.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Signal Station, Traffic
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of station based on the traffic service provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Port Control
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels within a port.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Port Entry and Departure
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a port.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: International Port Traffic
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station displaying International Port Traffic signals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Berthing Signal Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels when berthing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a dock.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a lock.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flood Barrage Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels wishing to pass through a flood control barrage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bridge Passage
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels wishing to pass under a bridge.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dredging
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station indicating when dredging is in progress.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Traffic Control Light
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Visual signal lights placed in a waterway to indicate to shipping the movements authorized at the time at which they are shown.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Signal Station, Warning
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of station based on the warning service provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Danger
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a danger to navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Maritime Obstruction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a maritime obstruction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cable
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of the presence of a cable.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military Practice
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of activity in a military practice area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Distress
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A station that may receive or transmit distress signals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Weather
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A visual signal displayed to indicate a weather forecast.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Storm
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information about storm conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Warning
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information about ice conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Time
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An accurate signal marking a specified time or time interval. It is used primarily for determining errors of timepieces. Such signals are usually sent from an observatory by radio, but visual signals are used at some ports.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information on tidal conditions in the area in question.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tidal Stream
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message conveying information on condition of tidal currents in the area in question.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide Gauge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A device for measuring the height of tide. A graduated staff in a sheltered area where visual observations can be made; or it may consist of an elaborate recording instrument making a continuous graphic record of tide height against time. Such an instrument is usually actuated by a float in a pipe communicating with the sea through a small hole which filters out shorter waves.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide Scale
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A visual scale which directly shows the height of the water above chart datum or a local datum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diving
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal or message warning of diving activity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Level Gauge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A device for measuring and conveying information about the water level (non-tidal) in the area in question.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vertical Clearance Indication
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An indication of the vertical clearance of a bridge, overhead cable, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Depth Indication
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An indication of the local depth.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Silo/Tank
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification based on the product for which a silo or tank is used.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Silo in General
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large storage structure used for storing loose materials.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tank in General
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fixed structure for storing liquids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Grain Elevator
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A storage building for grain. Usually a tall frame, metal or concrete structure with an especially compartmented interior.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Tower
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tower supporting an elevated storage tank of water.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Slope
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of a stretch of ground forming a natural or artificial incline.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cutting
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An excavation through high ground for a road, canal, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Embankment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A man-made raised long mound of earth or other material.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dune
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mound, ridge or hill of drifted material on the sea coast or in a desert.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hill
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: [1] A small isolated elevation, smaller than a mountain. [2] A distinct elevation generally of irregular shape, less than 1000m above the surrounding relief as measured from the deepest isobath that surrounds most of the feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pingo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A dome-shaped hill formed in a permafrost area when the hydrostatic pressure of freezing ground water causes the upheaval of a layer of frozen ground.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cliff
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Land rising abruptly for a considerable distance above the water or surrounding land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Scree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mass of detritus, forming a precipitous, strong slope upon a mountain-side. Also the material composing such a slope.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Small Craft Facility
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of services and facilities for the small craft user.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Visitors Berth
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A berth set aside for the use of visiting vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nautical Club
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A club for mariners generally associated with other small craft facilities.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boat Hoist
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A hoist for lifting boats out of the water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sailmaker
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where sails are made or may be taken for repair.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boatyard
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place on shore where boats may be built, stored and repaired.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Public Inn
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A public house providing food, drink and accommodation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Restaurant
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A commercial establishment serving food.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Chandler
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A dealer in ships' supplies.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Provisions
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where food and other such supplies are available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Doctor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where a doctor is available to provide medical attention.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pharmacy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where medical drugs are dispensed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Tap
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where fresh water is available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fuel Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where fuel is available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Electricity Outlet
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where a connection to an electrical supply is available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bottle Gas
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where bottled gas is available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Showers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where showers are available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Launderette
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where there are facilities for washing clothes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Public Toilets
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where toilets are available for public use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Post Box
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where mail may be posted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Public Telephone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where a telephone is available for public use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refuse Bin
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where refuse may be dumped.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Car Park
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where cars may be parked.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Parking for Boats and Trailers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place on shore where boats and/or trailers may be parked.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Caravan Site
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where caravans may be parked or where caravan accommodation is provided.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Camping Site
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where visitors may pitch tents and camp.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sewage Pump-Out Station
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where sewage may be pumped off a vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Emergency Telephone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where a telephone is available for emergency use only.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Landing/Launching Place for Boats
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where boats may be landed or launched.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Visitors Mooring
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mooring set aside for the use of visiting vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Scrubbing Berth
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where vessels may berth for the purpose of careening.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Picnic Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where people may go to eat a picnic.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mechanics Workshop
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where mechanical repairs can be undertaken to engines or other vessel equipment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Guard and/or Security Service
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A place where a vessel is patrolled by a security service or stored in a secure lockup.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Special Purpose Mark
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an aid to navigation which signifies some special purpose.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: A mark may be a beacon, a buoy, a signpost or may take another form.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Firing Danger Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a firing danger area, usually at sea.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Target Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any object toward which something is directed. The distinctive marking or instrumentation of a ground point to aid its identification on a photograph.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Marker Ship Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark marking the position of a ship which is used as a target during some military exercise.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Degaussing Range Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a degaussing range.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Barge Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark of relevance to barges.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cable Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine cables or the point at which they run on to the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spoil Ground Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the limit of a spoil ground.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Outfall Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the position of an outfall or the point at which it leaves the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: ODAS
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Ocean Data Acquisition System.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recording Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to record data for scientific purposes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seaplane Anchorage Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a seaplane anchorage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recreation Zone Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a recreation zone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Private Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A privately maintained mark.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mooring Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a mooring or moorings.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: LANBY
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A large buoy designed to take the place of a lightship where construction of an offshore light station is not feasible.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Leading Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Aids to navigation or other indicators so located as to indicate the path to be followed. Leading marks identify a leading line when they are in transit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Measured Distance Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark forming part of a transit indicating one end of a measured distance.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Notice Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A notice board or sign indicating information to the mariner.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: TSS Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a Traffic Separation Scheme.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Anchoring Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an anchoring prohibited area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Berthing Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that berthing is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Overtaking Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that overtaking is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Two-Way Traffic Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a one-way route.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reduced Wake Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that vessels must not generate excessive wake.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Speed Limit Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that a speed limit applies.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stop Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the place where the bow of a ship must stop when traffic lights show red.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: General Warning Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that special caution must be exercised in the vicinity of the mark.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sound Ship's Siren Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that a ship should sound its siren or horn.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Restricted Vertical Clearance Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the minimum vertical space available for passage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Maximum Vessel's Draught Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the maximum draught of vessel permitted.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Restricted Horizontal Clearance Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the minimum horizontal space available for passage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Strong Current Warning Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark warning of strong currents.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Berthing Permitted Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that berthing is allowed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Overhead Power Cable Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an overhead power cable.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Channel Edge Gradient Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the gradient of the slope of a dredge channel edge.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Telephone Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the presence of a telephone.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ferry Crossing Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that a ferry route crosses the ship route; often used with a 'sound ship's siren' mark.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pipeline Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the position of submarine pipelines or the point at which they run on to the land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Anchorage Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an anchorage area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Clearing Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate a clearing line.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Control Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the location at which a restriction or requirement exists.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diving Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that diving may take place in the vicinity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Refuge Beacon
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark providing or indicating a place of safety.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Foul Ground Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a foul ground.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Yachting Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark installed for use by yachtsmen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Heliport Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an area where helicopters may land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: GNSS Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a location at which a GNSS position has been accurately determined.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seaplane Landing Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating an area where seaplanes land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Entry Prohibited Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that entry is prohibited.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Work in Progress Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating that work (generally construction) is in progress.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mark With Unknown Purpose
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark whose detailed characteristics are unknown.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wellhead Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating a borehole that produces or is capable of producing oil or natural gas.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Channel Separation Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the point at which a channel divides separately into two channels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Marine Farm Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the existence of a fish, mussel, oyster or pearl farm/culture.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Artificial Reef Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark indicating the existence or the extent of an artificial reef.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ice Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark, used year round, that may be submerged when ice passes through the area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nature Reserve Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to define the boundary of a nature reserve.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fish Aggregating Device
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fish aggregating (or aggregation) device (FAD) is a man-made object used to attract ocean going pelagic fish such as marlin, tuna and mahi-mahi (dolphin fish). They usually consist of buoys or floats tethered to the ocean floor with concrete blocks or adrift.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wreck Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a wreck.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Customs Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a customs checkpoint.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Causeway Mark
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A mark used to indicate the existence of a causeway.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wave Recorder
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A surface following buoy used to measure wave activity.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Temporal Variation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: An assessment of the likelihood of change over time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Extreme Event
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Indication of the possible impact of a significant event (for example hurricane, earthquake, volcanic eruption, landslide, etc), which is considered likely to have changed the seafloor or landscape significantly.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Likely to Change and Significant Shoaling Expected
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous or frequent change (for example river siltation, sand waves, seasonal storms, icebergs, etc) that is likely to result in new significant shoaling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Likely to Change But Significant Shoaling Not Expected
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous or frequent change (for example sand wave shift, seasonal storms, icebergs, etc) that is not likely to result in new significant shoaling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Likely to Change
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous or frequent change to non-bathymetric features (for example river siltation, glacier creep/recession, sand dunes, buoys, marine farms, etc).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unlikely to Change
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Significant change to the seafloor is not expected.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unassessed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Not having been assessed.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Structure
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of a covered or partially covered area where different use types of vessel can berth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Boathouse
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A building or shed, usually built partly over water, for sheltering a boat or boats.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Covered Bulk Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A covered or partially covered terminal for the handling of bulk materials such as iron ore, coal, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Covered Wharf
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A covered or partially covered structure serving as a berthing place for vessels.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Covered Service Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A covered or partially covered terminal within which the floating equipment (dredges, tugs …) of harbour services are berthed and serviced.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Covered Passenger Terminal
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A covered or partially covered terminal for the loading and unloading of passengers.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Tidal Stream
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the alternating horizontal movement of water associated with the rise and fall of the tide caused by tide producing forces.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flood Stream
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The horizontal movement of water associated with the rising tide. Flood streams generally set towards the shore, or in the direction of the tide progression.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ebb Stream
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The horizontal movement of water associated with falling tide. Ebb streams generally set seaward, or in the opposite direction to the tide progression.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other Tidal Flow
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any other horizontal movement of water associated with tides, for example rotary flow.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Vegetation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the plant life of an area or region.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bush
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shrub or clump of shrubs with stems of moderate length.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Deciduous Wood
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wood with trees that shed their leaves annually.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coniferous Wood
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wood with evergreen trees of a group usually bearing cones, including yews, cedars and redwoods.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wood in General (inc Mixed Wood)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Growing trees densely occupying a tract of land.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: [1] A reed uses compressed air and emits a weak, high pitched sound. [2] Any of various water or marsh plants with a firm stem. (Concise Oxford English Dictionary)

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tree in General
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An individual woody perennial plant, typically having a single stem or trunk growing to a considerable height and bearing lateral branches at some distance from the ground.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Evergreen Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having green foliage all the year round.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coniferous Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cone-bearing, needle-leaved or scale-leaved evergreen tree.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Palm Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tropical or sub-tropical tree, shrub or vine having a tall, unbranched, columnar trunk. The trunk is crowned by a tuft or large, pleated fan or feather shaped leaves with stout sheathing and often prickly petioles (stalks), the persistent bases of which frequently clothe the trunk.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nipa Palm Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rare palm tree with regular branching involving equal or sub-equal division of the apex that results in forking.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Casuarina Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tree characterized by slender, green, often drooping branches that are deeply grooved and that bear, at intervals, whorls of tine leaves.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Eucalypt Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An instance of a large genus of mostly very large trees (90 metres).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Deciduous Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Sheds its leaves each year at the end of the period of growth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Filao Tree
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Casuarina equisetifolia, the most widespread and well-known member of the family Casuarinaceae.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Water Turbulence
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of an unstable sea state.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Breakers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wave breaking on the shore, over a reef, etc. Breakers may be roughly classified into three kinds, although the categories may overlap: spilling breakers break gradually over a considerable distance; plunging breakers tend to curl over and break with a crash; and surging breakers peak up, but then instead of spilling or plunging they surge up on the beach face. The French word 'brisant' is also used for the obstacle causing the breaking of the wave.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Eddies
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Circular movements of water usually formed where currents pass obstructions, between two adjacent currents flowing counter to each other, or along the edge of a permanent current.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Overfalls
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Short, breaking waves occurring when a strong current passes over a shoal or other submarine obstruction or meets a contrary current or wind.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tide Rips
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Small waves formed on the surface of water by the meeting of opposing tidal currents or by a tidal current crossing an irregular bottom. Vertical oscillation, rather than progressive waves, is characteristic of tide rips.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bombora
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wave that forms over a submerged offshore reef or rock, sometimes (in very calm weather or at high tide) nearly swelling but in other conditions breaking heavily and producing a dangerous stretch of broken water; the reef or rock itself.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Under Water Turbulence
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An under water turbulence.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Weed/Kelp
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of marine vegetation of the algae class.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Kelp
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A giant plant sometimes 60 metres long with no roots, it is anchored by hold-fasts or tendrils up to 10 metres long, that cling to rock. Gas filled bubbles on fronds act as floats keeping the kelp just below the surface.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Seaweed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The general name for marine plants of the Algae class which grow in long narrow ribbons.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sargasso
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A certain type of seaweed, or more generally, a large floating mass of this seaweed.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Wreck
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of a wrecked or ruined ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Non-Dangerous Wreck
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wreck which is not considered to be dangerous to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dangerous Wreck
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A wreck submerged at such a depth as to be considered dangerous to surface navigation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Distributed Remains of Wreck
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A substantively decayed wreck over which it is safe to navigate but which should be avoided for anchoring, taking the ground or ground fishing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wreck Showing Mast/Masts
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Wreck of which only the mast(s) is visible at the sounding datum indicated.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wreck Showing Any Portion of Hull or Superstructure
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Wreck of which any portion of the hull or superstructure is visible at the sounding datum indicated.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Zone of Confidence In Data
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the zone of confidence in data within an area based on the positional accuracy, survey equipment and coverage.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: See S-57 Appendix A, Chapter 2, Page 2.107 for the full list of ZOC categories.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Zone of Confidence A1
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 5 metres + 5% depth; Depth Accuracy 0.5 metre + 1% depth; Full area search undertaken. Significant seafloor features detected and depths measured; Controlled, systematic survey, high position and depth accuracy achieved using DGPS or a minimum three high quality lines of position (LOP) and a multibeam, channel or mechanical sweep system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Zone of Confidence A2
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 20 metres; Depth Accuracy 1.0 metre + 2% depth; Full area search undertaken. Significant seafloor features detected and depths measured; Controlled, systematic survey achieving position and depth accuracy less than ZOC A1 and using a modern survey echosounder and a sonar or mechanical sweep system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Zone of Confidence B
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 50 metres; Depth Accuracy 1.0 metre + 2% depth; Full area search not achieved, uncharted features hazardous to surface navigation are not expected but may exist; Controlled, systematic survey achieving similar depth but lesser position accuracies than ZOCA2, using a modern survey echosounder, but no sonar or mechanical sweep system.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Zone of Confidence C
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Positional Accuracy +/- 500 metres; Depth Accuracy 2.0 metre + 5% depth; Full area search not achieved, depth anomalies may be expected; Low accuracy survey or data collected on an opportunity basis such as soundings on passage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Zone of Confidence D
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Positional Accuracy worse than ZOC C; Depth Accuracy worse than ZOC C; Full area search not achieved, large depth anomalies may be expected; Poor quality data or data that cannot be quality assessed due to lack of information.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Zone of Confidence U
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The quality of the bathymetric data has yet to be assessed.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Colour
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye as a result of the way it reflects or emits light.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: White
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The achromatic object colour of greatest lightness characteristically perceived to belong to objects that reflect diffusely nearly all incident energy throughout the visible spectrum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Black
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The achromatic color of least lightness characteristically perceived to belong to objects that neither reflect nor transmit light.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Red
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A color whose hue resembles that of blood or of the ruby or is that of the long-wave extreme of the visible spectrum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Green
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Of the color green.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Blue
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A color whose hue is that of the clear sky or that of the portion of the color spectrum lying between green and violet.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Yellow
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A color whose hue resembles that of ripe lemons or sunflowers or is that of the portion of the spectrum lying between green and orange.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Grey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Of the color grey.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Brown
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any of a group of colors between red and yellow in hue, of medium to low lightness, and of moderate to low saturation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Amber
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A variable color averaging a dark orange yellow.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Violet
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any of a group of colors of reddish-blue hue, low lightness, and medium saturation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Orange
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any of a group of colors that are between red and yellow in hue.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Magenta
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A deep purplish red.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pink
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any of a group of colors bluish red to red in hue, of medium to high lightness, and of low to moderate saturation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Colour Pattern
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A regular repeated design containing more than one colour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Horizontal Stripes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented horizontally.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vertical Stripes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented vertically.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diagonal Stripes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented diagonally (that is, not horizontally or vertically).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Squared
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Often referred to as checker plate, where alternate colours are used to create squares similar to a chess or draught board. The pattern may be straight or diagonal.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Stripes (Direction Unknown)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Straight bands or stripes of differing colours oriented in an unknown direction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Border Stripe
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A band or stripe of colour which is displayed around the outer edge of the feature, which may also form a border to an inner pattern or plain colour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Single Colour
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: One solid colour of uniform coverage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rectangle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A four-sided shape that is made up of two pairs of parallel lines and that has four right angles, on a different coloured background.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Triangle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A shape that is made up of three lines and three angles, on a different coloured background.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Communication Channel
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A channel number assigned to a specific radio frequency, frequencies or frequency band.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The expected input is the specific VHF-Channel. The attribute 'communication channel' encodes the various VHF-channels used for communication.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Condition
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The various conditions of buildings and other constructions.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The default 'condition' should be considered to be completed, undamaged and working normally.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Under Construction
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being built but not yet capable of function.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ruined
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A structure in a decayed or deteriorated condition resulting from neglect or disuse, or a damaged structure in need of repair.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Under Reclamation
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area of the sea, a lake or the navigable part of a river that is being reclaimed as land, usually by the dumping of earth and other material.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Wingless
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A windmill or wind turbine from which the vanes or turbine blades are missing.
