S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The identification number of the reference tide station with reference water level for tidal stream panel observations.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Status
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The condition of an object at a given instant in time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Permanent
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Intended to last or function indefinitely.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Occasional
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Acting on special occasions; happening irregularly.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recommended
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Presented as worthy of confidence, acceptance, use, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Not in Use
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Use has ceased, but the facility still exists intact; disused.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Periodic/Intermittent
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Recurring at intervals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reserved
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Set apart for some specific use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Temporary
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Meant to last only for a time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Private
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Administered by an individual or corporation, rather than a State or a public body.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mandatory
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Compulsory; enforced.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Extinguished
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: No longer lit.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Illuminated
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Lit by flood lights, strip lights, etc.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Historic
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Famous in history; of historical interest.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Public
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Belonging to, available to, used or shared by, the community as a whole and not restricted to private use.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Synchronized
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Occur at a time, coincide in point of time, be contemporary or simultaneous.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Watched
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Looked at or observed over a period of time especially so as to be aware of any movement or change.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Unwatched
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Usually automatic in operation, without any permanently-stationed personnel to superintend it.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Existence Doubtful
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A feature that has been reported but has not been definitely determined to exist.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Buoyed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Marked by buoys.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Stream Depth
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The depth below the sea surface to which the tidal stream data refers relative to the sounding datum.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Surrounding Depth
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The depth value determined for seabed around an underwater hazard, based on the depth of the surrounding area.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The value for surrounding depth is determined from the attribute depth range minimum value for the surrounding encoded Depth Area. For an area feature covered by more than one depth area, the surrounding depth is determined as the depth range minimum attribute value of the deeper of the depth areas covering the feature.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Survey Authority
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The authority which was responsible for the survey.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: Encodes the name of the source survey authority. (Examples: Hydrographic Service, Royal Australian Navy; Port of Melbourne Authority.)

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Survey Type
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the different survey types.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reconnaissance/Sketch Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey made (due to lack of time or facilities) to a lower degree of accuracy and detail than the chosen scale would normally indicate.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Controlled Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A thorough survey usually conducted with reference to guidelines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Examination Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey principally aimed at the investigation of underwater obstructions and dangers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Passage Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey where soundings are acquired by vessels on passage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Remotely Sensed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey where features have been positioned and delimited using remote sensing techniques.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Full Coverage
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey achieving 100% coverage using systematic, controlled techniques providing full seafloor coverage or full coverage to a defined depth and an investigation of all contacts.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Systematic Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A controlled survey but full coverage may not have been achieved.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Non-Systematic Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey of lower quality than a full coverage and systematic survey. Such surveys may be further categorized as reconnaissance, sketch, track, passage, remotely sensed and spot-sounding surveys.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Inadequately Surveyed
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Not surveyed to modern standards; or due to its age, scale, or positional or vertical uncertainties is not suitable to the type of navigation expected in the area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Spot-Sounding Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A survey that uses a regular (for example grid) or irregular pattern of soundings obtained one at a time, and normally with very wide spacing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Acoustically Swept Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A controlled, systematic survey to standard accuracy; using modern survey echo sounder with sonar sweep.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mechanically Swept Survey
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Swept areas where the clearance depth is accurately known but the actual seabed depth is not accurately known.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Update Number
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Update number of the ENC being referenced.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Update Type
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: An action performed when the contents of a dataset are changed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Insert
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: To put or introduce into the body of something.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Delete
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: To eliminate especially by removing, cutting out or erasing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Modify
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: To make basic or fundamental changes to the characteristics of something, often to give a new orientation to or to serve a new end.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Move
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: To change the place or position of something.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Technique of Vertical Measurement
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Survey method used to obtain depth information.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Echo Sounder
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using an instrument that determines depth of water by measuring the time interval between emission of a sonic or ultrasonic signal and return of its echo from the bottom.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Side Scan Sonar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was computed from a record produced by active sonar in which fixed acoustic beams are directed into the water perpendicularly to the direction of travel to scan the seabed and generate a record of the seabed configuration.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Multi Beam
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using a wide swath echo sounder that uses multiple beams to measure depths directly below and transverse to the ship's track.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Diver
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by a person skilled in the practice of diving.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Lead Line
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using a line, graduated with attached marks and fastened to a sounding lead.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swept by Wire-Drag
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a buoyed wire at the desired depth by two launches, or a least depth was identified using the same technique.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swept by Vertical Acoustic System
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area has been swept using a system comprised of multiple echo sounder transducers attached to booms deployed from the survey vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Electromagnetic Sensor
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using an instrument that compares electromagnetic signals.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Photogrammetry
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The science or art of obtaining reliable measurements from photographs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Satellite Imagery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using instruments placed aboard an artificial satellite.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by Levelling
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was determined by using levelling techniques to find the elevation of the point relative to a datum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Swept by Side Scan Sonar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a side scan sonar.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Found by LIDAR
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The depth was measured by using an instrument that measures distance by emitting timed pulses of laser light and measuring the time between emission and reception of the reflected pulses.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Synthetic Aperture Radar
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A radar with a synthetic aperture antenna which is composed of a large number of elementary transducing elements. The signals are electronically combined into a resulting signal equivalent to that of a single antenna of a given aperture in a given direction.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Hyperspectral Imagery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term used to describe the imagery derived from subdividing the electromagnetic spectrum into very narrow bandwidths. These narrow bandwidths may be combined with or subtracted from each other in various ways to form images useful in precise terrain or target analysis.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mechanically Swept
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The given area was determined to be free from navigational dangers to a certain depth by towing a line or object below the surface at the desired depth; or least depth(s) and position(s) within an area was identified using the same technique.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Telecommunication Identifier
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: An identifier, such as words, numbers, letters, symbols, or any combination of those used to establish a contact to a particular person, organisation or service.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Telecommunication Service
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of methods of communication over a distance by electrical, electronic, or electromagnetic means.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Voice
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The transfer or exchange of information by using sounds that are being made by mouth and throat when speaking.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Facsimile
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A system of transmitting and reproducing graphic matter (as printing or still pictures) by means of signals sent over telephone lines.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: SMS
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Short Message Service is a form of text messaging communication on phones and mobile phones.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Data
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A representation of facts, concepts or instructions in a formalised manner suitable for communication, interpretation or processing.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Streamed Data
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Data that is constantly received by and presented to an end-user while being delivered by a provider.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Telex
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A system of communication in which messages are sent over long distances by using a telephone system and are printed by using a special machine (called a teletypewriter).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Telegraph
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An apparatus, system or process for communication at a distance by electric transmission over wire.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Email
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Messages and other data exchanged between individuals using computers in a network.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Text
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A non-formatted digital text string.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: Should be used, for example, to hold the information that is for short cautionary or explanatory notes. Therefore, text populated in text must not exceed 300 characters. Text may be in English, or in a national language. No formatting of text is possible within text. If formatted text, or text strings exceeding 300 characters, is required, then an alternate concept should be used.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Text Offset Bearing
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The angular distance measured from true north that text associated with a feature is positioned from the feature in an end-user system.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Text Offset Distance
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The distance that text associated with a feature is positioned from the feature in an end-user system.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Text Rotation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A statement that expresses if text associated with a feature is to be rotated in the ECDIS display or not.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Text Type
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The attribute from which a text string is derived.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Name
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The individual name of a feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Feature Characteristic
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A distinguishing trait, quality, or property of a feature class.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Time of Day End
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The time corresponding to the end of an active period.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The time of day end must be encoded using 2 digits for the hour (hh), 2 digits for the minutes(mm) and 2 digits for the seconds (ss). This conforms to ISO 8601:2004.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Time of Day Start
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The time corresponding to the start of an active period.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The time of day start must be encoded using 2 digits for the hour (hh), 2 digits for the minutes(mm) and 2 digits for the seconds (ss). This conforms to ISO 8601:2004.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Time Relative to Tide
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The time difference relative to the reference tide.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: Positive values are time after the referenced tide, negative values are time before the referenced tide.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Topmark/Daymark Shape
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The shape a topmark or daymark exhibits.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cone (Point Up)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Is where the vertex points up.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cone (Point Down)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Is where the vertex points down.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sphere
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A curved surface all points of which are equidistant from a fixed point within, called the centre.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: 2 Spheres
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Two spheres, one above the other. Two black spheres are commonly used as an International Association of Lighthouse Authorities - IALA topmark (isolated danger).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cylinder
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A solid geometrical figure generated by straight lines fixed in direction and describing with one of point a closed curve, especially a circle (in which case the figure is circular cylinder, its ends being parallel circles).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Board
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Usually of rectangular shape, made from timber or metal and used to provide a contrast with the natural background of a daymark. The actual daymark is often painted on to this board.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: X-Shaped
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having a shape or a cross-section like the capital letter X.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Upright Cross
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cross with one vertical member and one horizontal member; that is, similar in shape to the character '+'.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cube (Point Up)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A cube standing on one of its vertexes. A cube is a solid contained by six equal squares, a regular hexahedron.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: 2 Cones (Point to Point)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their vertices together in the centre.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: 2 Cones (Base to Base)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their bases together in the centre and their vertices pointing up and down.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rhombus
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A plane figure having four equal sides and equal opposite angles (two acute and two obtuse); an oblique equilateral parallelogram.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: 2 Cones (Points Upward)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their vertices pointing up.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: 2 Cones (Points Downward)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: 2 cones, one above the other, with their vertices pointing down.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Besom (Point Up)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A bundle of rods or twigs. A besom, point up is where the thicker (untied) end of the besom is at the bottom.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Besom (Point Down)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A bundle of rods or twigs. A besom, point down is where the thinner (tied) end of the besom is at the bottom.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Flag
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A flag mounted on a short pole.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sphere Over a Rhombus
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A sphere located above a rhombus.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Square
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A plane figure with four right angles and four equal straight sides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rectangle (Horizontal)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A horizontal rectangle is where the two longer opposite sides are standing horizontally.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rectangle (Vertical)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vertical rectangle is where the two longer opposite sides are standing vertically.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Trapezium (Up)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A quadrilateral having one pair of opposite sides parallel, and which stands on its longer parallel side.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Trapezium (Down)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A quadrilateral having one pair of opposite sides parallel, and which stands on its shorter parallel side.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Triangle (Point Up)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A figure having three angles and three sides, and which has a vertex at the top.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Triangle (Point Down)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A figure having three angles and three sides, and which has a side at the top.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Circle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A perfectly round plane figure whose circumference is everywhere equidistant from its centre.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Two Upright Crosses (One Over the Other)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Two upright crosses, generally vertically disposed one above the other.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: T-Shape
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having a shape like the capital letter T.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Triangle Pointing Up Over a Circle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A triangle, vertex uppermost, located above a circle.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Upright Cross Over a Circle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An upright cross located above a circle.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rhombus Over a Circle
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rhombus located above a circle.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Circle Over a Triangle Pointing Up
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A circle located over a triangle, vertex uppermost.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other Shape (See Shape Information)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An uncommon and/or non-standardized shape as textually described using an associated attribute.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tubular
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Having the form of or consisting of a tube.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Traffic Flow
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Direction of vessels passing a reference point.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Inbound
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Traffic flow in a general direction toward a port or similar destination.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Outbound
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Traffic flow in a general direction away from a port or similar point of origin.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: One-Way
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Traffic flow in one general direction only.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Two-Way
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Traffic flow in two generally opposite directions.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Uncertainty Fixed
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The best estimate of the fixed horizontal or vertical accuracy component for positions, depths, heights, vertical distances and vertical clearances.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Uncertainty Variable Factor
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The factor to be applied to the variable component of an uncertainty equation so as to provide the best estimate of the variable horizontal or vertical accuracy component for positions, depths, heights, vertical distances and vertical clearances.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Underlying Layer
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The position of the seabed type within the layers of the seabed.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Annual Change in Magnetic Variation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The annual change in magnetic variation values.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: A positive value; that is, unsigned, indicates a change in an easterly direction and a negative value indicates a change in a westerly direction.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Depth Contour
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The depth of a sea bottom contour.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: Drying contours are indicated by a negative value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Magnetic Variation
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The angle between the magnetic and geographical meridians at any place, expressed in degrees east or west to indicate the direction of magnetic north from true north.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: A positive value; that is, unsigned, indicates variation in an easterly direction and a negative value indicates variation in a westerly direction.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Maximum Range
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The extreme distance at which a feature can be seen or a signal detected.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: Does not apply to lights where the "value of nominal range" should be used.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Nominal Range
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The luminous range of a light in a homogenous atmosphere in which the meteorological visibility is 10 sea miles.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Value of Sounding
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The value of the measurement of a sounding relative to the chart datum.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: A drying height is indicated by a negative value.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Clearance Unlimited
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A statement that expresses if the vertical clearance for a feature in the open position, such as a bridge span, is unlimited.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Clearance Value
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The vertical clearance measured from the horizontal plane towards the feature overhead.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Datum
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The reference level used for expressing the vertical measurements of points on the earth's surface. Also called datum level, reference plane, levelling datum, datum for sounding reduction, datum for heights.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Low Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of the low waters of spring tides. This level is used as a tidal datum in some areas.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Lower Low Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of lower low water springs at a place.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Sea Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of the surface of the sea at a tide station for all stages of the tide over a 19-year period, usually determined from hourly height readings measured from a fixed predetermined reference level.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lowest Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level conforming to the lowest tide observed at a place, or somewhat lower.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of all low waters at a place over a 19-year period.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lowest Low Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level conforming to the lowest water level observed at a place at spring tides during a period of time shorter than 19 years.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Approximate Mean Low Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Low Water Springs (MLWS).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Indian Spring Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary tidal datum approximating the level of the mean of the lower low water at spring tides. It was first used in waters surrounding India.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Low Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, approximating that of mean low water springs (MLWS).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Approximate Lowest Astronomical Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Lowest Astronomical Tide (LAT).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nearly Lowest Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level approximating the lowest water level observed at a place, usually equivalent to the Indian Spring Low Water (ISLW).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Lower Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of the lower low waters at a place over a 19-year period.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The lowest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Approximate Mean Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Low Water (MLW).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Approximate Mean Lower Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Lower Low Water (MLLW).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean High Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of all high waters at a place over a 19-year period.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean High Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of the high waters of spring tides.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: High Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The highest level reached at a place by the water surface in one oscillation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Approximate Mean Sea Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, usually within 0.3m from that of Mean Sea Level (MSL).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: High Water Springs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level, approximating that of mean high water springs (MHWS).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Higher High Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average height of higher high waters at a place over a 19-year period.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Equinoctial Spring Low Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The level of low water springs near the time of an equinox.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lowest Astronomical Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The lowest tide level which can be predicted to occur under average meteorological conditions and under any combination of astronomical conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Local Datum
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary datum defined by a local harbour authority, from which levels and tidal heights are measured by this authority.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: International Great Lakes Datum 1985
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vertical reference system with its zero based on the mean water level at Rimouski/Pointe-au-Père, Quebec, over the period 1970 to 1988.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Water Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average of all hourly water levels over the available period of record.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lower Low Water Large Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average of the lowest low waters, one from each of 19 years of observations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Higher High Water Large Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The average of the highest high waters, one from each of 19 years of observations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Nearly Highest High Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An arbitrary level approximating the highest water level observed at a place, usually equivalent to the high water springs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Highest Astronomical Tide
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The highest tidal level which can be predicted to occur under average meteorological conditions and under any combination of astronomical conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Local Low Water Reference Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Low water reference level of the local area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Local High Water Reference Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: High water reference level of the local area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Local Mean Water Reference Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Mean water reference level of the local area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Equivalent Height of Water (German GlW)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A low water level which is the result of a defined low water discharge - called "equivalent discharge".

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Highest Shipping Height of Water (German HSW)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Upper limit of water levels where navigation is allowed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reference Low Water Level According to Danube Commission
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The water level at a discharge, which is exceeded 94 % of the year within a period of 30 years.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Highest Shipping Height of Water According to Danube Commission
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The water level at a discharge, which is exceeded 1% of the year within a period of 30 years.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dutch River Low Water Reference Level (OLR)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The water level at a discharge, which is exceeded 95% of the year within a period of 20 years.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Russian Project Water Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Conditional low water level with established probability.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Russian Normal Backwater Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Highest water level derived from the upper backwater stream in watercourse or reservoir under the normal operational conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ohio River Datum
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The Ohio River datum.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dutch High Water Reference Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Dutch High Water Reference Level.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Baltic Sea Chart Datum 2000
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The datum refers to each Baltic country's realization of the European Vertical Reference System (EVRS) with land-uplift epoch 2000, which is connected to the Normaal Amsterdams Peil (NAP).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dutch Estuary Low Water Reference Level (OLW)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Dutch Estuary Low Water Reference Level (OLW)

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vertical Length
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The total vertical length of a feature.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: For floating objects: the vertical distance from the surface of water to the highest point of that object. For fixed objects: the vertical distance from seabed or ground to the highest point of that object. For objects on top of other objects: the vertical distance from the lowest to the highest point of that object. Vertical length measurements do not require a datum.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Vessel Class
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The classification of a vessel, normally as defined by length or gross tonnage.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Visitors Mooring
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A mooring set aside for the use of visiting vessels.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Visual Prominence
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The extent to which a feature, either natural or artificial, is visible from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Visually Conspicuous
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Term applied to an object either natural or artificial which is distinctly and notably visible from seaward.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Not Visually Conspicuous
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An object that may be visible from seaward, but cannot be used as a fixing mark and is not conspicuous.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Prominent
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Objects which are easily identifiable, but do not justify being classed as conspicuous.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Water Level Effect
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The effect of the surrounding water on an object.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Partly Submerged at High Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Partially covered and partially dry at high water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Always Dry
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Not covered at high water under average meteorological conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Always Under Water/Submerged
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Remains covered by water at all times under average meteorological conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Covers and Uncovers
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Expression intended to indicate an area of a reef or other projection from the bottom of a body of water which periodically extends above and is submerged below the surface. Also referred to as dries or uncovers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Awash
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Flush with, or washed by the waves at low water under average meteorological conditions.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Subject to Inundation or Flooding
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area periodically covered by flood water, excluding tidal waters.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Floating
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Resting or moving on the surface of a liquid without sinking.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Above Mean Water Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Above a water level called "Mean Water" which is the arithmetic mean value of all water levels within a certain period of time.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Below Mean Water Level
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Below a water level called "mean water", which is the arithmetic mean value of all water levels within a certain period of time.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Waterway Distance
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: [1] The distance measured from an origin of a river or canal. [2] The length of the space between two points along a waterway.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Wave Length Value
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The distance between two successive peaks (or other points of identical phase) on an electromagnetic wave.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Authority
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The type of person, government agency or organisation granted powers of managing or controlling access to and/or activity in an area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Border Control
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The administration to prevent or detect and prosecute violations of rules and regulations at international boundaries.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Police
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The department of government, or civil force, charged with maintaining public order.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Port
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: 1. Person or corporation, owners of, or entrusted with or invested with the power of managing a port. May be called a Harbour Board, Port Trust, Port Commission, Harbour Commission, Marine Department. 2. For port and near shore operations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Immigration
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The authority controlling people entering a country.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Health
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The authority with responsibility for checking the validity of the health declaration of a vessel and for declaring free pratique.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coast Guard
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Organization keeping watch on shipping and coastal waters according to governmental law; normally the authority with responsibility for search and rescue.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Agricultural
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The authority with responsibility for preventing infection of the agriculture of a country and for the protection of the agricultural interests of a country.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Military
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A military authority which provides control of access to or approval for transit through designated areas or airspace.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Private Company
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A private or publicly owned company or commercial enterprise which exercises control of facilities, for example a calibration area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Maritime Police
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A governmental or military force with jurisdiction in territorial waters. Examples could include Gendarmerie Maritime, Carabinierie, and Guardia Civil.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Environmental
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An authority with responsibility for the protection of the environment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Fishery
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An authority with responsibility for the control of fisheries.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Finance
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An authority with responsibility for the control and movement of money.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Maritime
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A national or regional authority charged with administration of maritime affairs.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Customs
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The agency or establishment for collecting duties, tolls.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Cargo
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Classification of the different types of cargo that a ship may be carrying.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: If item 7 is used, the nature of dangerous or hazardous cargoes can be amplified with category of dangerous or hazardous cargo.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bulk
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Unpacked homogenous cargo poured loose in a certain space of a vessel, for example oil or grain.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Container
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: One of a number of standard sized cargo carrying units, secured using standard corner attachments and bar.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: General
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Break bulk cargo normally loaded by crane.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquid
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any cargo loaded by pipeline.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Passenger
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A fee paying traveller.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Livestock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Live animals carried in bulk.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dangerous or Hazardous
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Dangerous or hazardous cargo as described by the IMO International Maritime Dangerous Goods code.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Heavy Lift
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Indivisible heavy items of weight generally over 100 tons, and width or height greater than 100 metres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ballast
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Material carried by a ship to ensure its stability.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dry Bulk Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodity cargo that is transported unpackaged in large quantities. These types of goods usually need to be kept dry during the whole transportation period.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquid Bulk Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Liquids or gases that are transported in bulk and carried unpackaged.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Reefer Container Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Cargo transported in refrigerated containers, generally perishable commodities which require temperature-controlled transportation, such as fruit, meat, fish, vegetables, dairy products and other foods.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ro-Ro Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Wheeled cargo, such as cars, busses, trucks, agricultural vehicles and cranes, that are driven on and off the ship on their own wheels or using a platform vehicle, such as a self-propelled modular transporter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Project Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Project cargo is a term used to broadly describe the national or international transportation of large, heavy, high value, or critical (to the project they are intended for) pieces of equipment. Also commonly referred to as heavy lift, this includes shipments made of various components which need disassembly for shipment and reassembly after delivery.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Break Bulk Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Goods that are stowed on board ship in individually counted units, and not in intermodal containers nor in bulk as with oil or grain.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Minimum Berth Depth
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The least depth of the body of water at the berth or in a berth pocket adjacent to the berth.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The minimum depth is measured from a specified sounding datum. A berth pocket is the body of water at a berth or anchor berth, of adequate dimensions to allow a vessel to make fast to the shore, mooring buoys, berthing dolphins or to anchor.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Optimum Display Scale
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The largest intended viewing scale for the data.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Bunker Vessel, Availability
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indication of the availability of a bunker vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bunker Vessel Available
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A bunker vessel is available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: No Bunker Vessel Available
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A bunker vessel is not available.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Bunker Station
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Category of bunker station.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Diesel Oil
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Diesel oil available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A colourless, odourless, tasteless liquid that is a compound of hydrogen and oxygen.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ballast
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Material carried by a ship to ensure its stability.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Power
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Power supply available.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Compressed Hydrogen Bunkering
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Transfer of compressed hydrogen to the fuel tanks of a ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquefied Hydrogen Bunkering
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Transfer of liquefied hydrogen to the fuel tanks of a ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Methanol Bunkering
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Transfer of methanol to the fuel tanks of a ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ammonia Bunkering
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Transfer of ammonia to the fuel tanks of a ship.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: UN Location Code
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Used to encode the UN Location Code (http://www.unece.org/cefact/locode/service/location.html) or - in Europe - the Inland Ship Reporting Standard (ISRS) Code.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The ISRS Code exists of: - UN country code (2 digits), - UN Location code (3 digits, "XXX" if not available), - Fairway section number (5 numerical digits, to be determined by the national authority; a side branch should have an own section number, when there are special restrictions, e.g. bridges), - terminal code or passage point code (5 alphanumerical digits, "00000" if not available), - fairway section hectometre (5 numerical digits, hectometre at the centre of the area, "00000" if not available). If the ISRS code is not available, the code of the Nordersoft RIS-Index may be used.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Communication
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Category of communication.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: VTS Centre
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The centre from which Vessel Traffic Services are operated. A VTS is a service implemented by a competent authority, designed to improve the safety and efficiency of vessel traffic and to protect the environment. The services should have the capability to interact with the traffic and to respond to traffic situations developing in the area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: VTS Sector
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The service area of a VTS centre.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: IVS Point
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A reporting point of the "Informatie en Volgsysteem voor de Scheepvaart" in the Netherlands.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: MIB
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A reporting point of the "Melde- und Informationssystem Binnenschifffahrt" in Germany.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A signal station for the control of vessels entering or leaving a lock.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bridge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: (1) An elevated structure extending across or over the weather deck of a vessel, or part of such a structure. The term is sometimes modified to indicate the intended use, such as navigating bridge or signal bridge. (2) A structure erected over a depression or an obstacle such as a body of water, railroad, etc., to provide a roadway for vehicles or pedestrians.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Custom
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Serves as a government checkpoint where customs duties are collected, the flow of goods are regulated and restrictions enforced, and shipments or vehicles are cleared for entering or leaving a country.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Harbour
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A reporting point of a harbour.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: WLAN Area
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area where free wireless network is available.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Exceptional Structure
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Category of exceptional navigational structure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lift-Lock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A lock of which the lock chamber itself is lifted vertically to level with the next waterway section.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Aqueduct
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A bridge supporting an artificially elevated channel, for the conveyance of water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sloping Plane Lock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A lock of which the lock chamber itself travels over a sloping plane to level with the next waterway section.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Water Slope Lock
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: In French "Pente d'Eau". A lock of which the lock chamber is formed by a sloping plane and moving gate, which is pushing a triangular section of water up along the slope to level with the next waterway section.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Name of Sounding Datum Reference Level
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Name of the water level depth values are referred to.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Sounding Datum Reference Level Value
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Local value of the sounding datum reference level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Related Issue
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indication of the related legal issue.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Usage of Waterway
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An issue that is related to the usage of the waterway.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Carriage of Equipment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The legal issue for the vessel is related to the carriage of equipment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Task, Operation
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A usually assigned piece of work, or a specific work process, often to be finished within a certain time.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Description of Legal Conditions
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Additional textual information which is related to the numerical description of the particular article/clause of the applicable law/regulation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Ship (Including)
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Including list of categories of ship for the applicability of a feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: All Types
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The sum of all of the different kinds (or sorts or types) of an entity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Non-Motorized Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel that is not propelled by an internal combustion engine, such as vessels propelled by wind or manual methods such as rowing or pedalling.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Craft
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel or item of floating equipment.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An inland waterway vessel or sea going ship.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Inland Waterway Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel intended solely or mainly for navigation on inland waterways.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Sea Going Ship
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel certificated for sea-going service.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Motor Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A motor cargo vessel or a motor tanker.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Motor Tanker
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel intended for the carriage of goods in fixed tanks and built to navigate independently under its own motive power.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Motor Cargo Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel, other than a motor tanker, intended for the carriage of goods and built to navigate independently under its own motive power.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Canal Barge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An inland waterway vessel not exceeding 38.5 m in length and 5.05 m in breadth and usually operating on the Rhine-Rhone-Canal.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tug
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel specially built to perform towing operations.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pusher
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel specially built to propel a pushed convoy.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Barge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A dumb barge or tank barge.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tank Barge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel intended for the carriage of goods in fixed tanks and built to be towed, either having no motive power of its own or having only sufficient motive power to perform restricted manoeuvres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dumb Barge
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel, other than a tank barge, intended for the carriage of goods and built to be towed, either having no motive power of its own or having only sufficient motive power to perform restricted manoeuvres.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Lighter
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A tank lighter, cargo lighter or ship borne lighter.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tank Lighter
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel intended for the carriage of goods in fixed tanks, built or specially modified to be pushed, either having no motive power of its own or having only sufficient motive power to perform restricted manoeuvres when not part of a pushed convoy.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cargo Lighter
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel, other than a tank lighter, intended for the carriage of goods and built or specially modified to be pushed, either having no motive power of its own or having only sufficient motive power to perform restricted manoeuvres when not part of a pushed convoy.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Ship Borne Lighter
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A lighter built to be carried aboard sea going ships and to navigate on inland waterways.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Passenger Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A day trip or cabin vessel constructed and equipped to carry more than 12 passengers.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Passenger Sailing Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A passenger vessel fitted out mainly with a view to propulsion under sail.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Day Trip Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A passenger vessel without overnight passenger cabins.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cabin Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A passenger vessel with overnight passenger cabins.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: High-Speed Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A motorized vessel capable of reaching speeds over 40km/h with respect to water.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Floating Equipment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A floating installation carrying working gear such as cranes, dredging equipment, pile drivers or elevators.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Worksite Craft
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel, appropriately built and equipped for use at worksites, such as a reclamation barge, hopper or pontoon barge, pontoon or stone-dumping vessel.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Recreational Craft
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vessel other than a passenger vessel, intended for sport or pleasure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dinghy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A boat for use in transport, rescue, salvage and work duties.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Floating Establishment
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Any floating installation not normally intended to be moved, such as a swimming bath, dock, jetty or boathouse.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Floating Object
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A raft or other structure, object or assembly capable of navigation, not being a vessel or floating equipment or establishment.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Ship (Excluding)
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Excluding list of categories of ship for the applicability of a feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: All Types
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The sum of all of the different kinds (or sorts or types) of an entity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Single Vessel
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A single vessel (no assembly or formation).

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Convoy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rigid or towed convoy of craft.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Formation
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The manner in which a convoy is assembled.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Rigid Convoy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A pushed convoy or breasted up formation.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Pushed Convoy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rigid assembly of craft of which at least one is positioned in front of the craft providing the power for propelling the convoy, known as the "pusher(s)"; a convoy composed of a pusher craft and a pushed craft coupled so as to permit guided articulation is also considered as rigid.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Breasted Up Formation
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An assembly of craft coupled rigidly side by side, none of which is positioned in front of the craft propelling the assembly.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Towed Convoy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An assembly of one or more craft, floating establishments or floating installations towed by one or more self-propelled craft forming part of the convoy.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A rigid assembly of craft of which at least one is positioned in front of the craft providing the power for propelling the convoy, known as the "pusher(s)"; a convoy composed of a pusher craft and a pushed craft coupled so as to permit guided articulation is also considered as rigid.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An assembly of craft coupled rigidly side by side, none of which is positioned in front of the craft propelling the assembly.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Towed Convoy
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An assembly of one or more craft, floating establishments or floating installations towed by one or more self-propelled craft forming part of the convoy.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Cargo (Including)
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Including list of categories of cargo for the applicability of a feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: All Types
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The sum of all of the different kinds (or sorts or types) of an entity.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Bulk
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Unpacked homogenous cargo poured loose in a certain space of a vessel, for example oil or grain.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Dry Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Goods, such as coal, metals, and grain, that are not liquid and are carried in large quantities by ship or in another large vehicle.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquid Cargo
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodities that are shipped in a liquefied state, by vessels designed to handle liquids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquid Cargo (Type N)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodities that are shipped in a liquefied state, by Type N vessels designed to handle liquids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Liquid Cargo (Type C)
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodities that are shipped in a liquefied state, by Type C vessels designed to handle liquids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Gas
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A substance with particles that can move freely, usually a fuel substance in the context of storage tanks.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Excluding list of categories of cargo for the applicability of a feature.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodities that are shipped in a liquefied state, by vessels designed to handle liquids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodities that are shipped in a liquefied state, by Type N vessels designed to handle liquids.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commodities that are shipped in a liquefied state, by Type C vessels designed to handle liquids.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Maximal Permitted Beam
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximal permitted beam (width of a ship's hull) of a vessel or convoy according to the particular article/clause of the applicable law/regulation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Maximal Permitted Draught
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximal permitted draught of a vessel or convoy according to the particular article/clause of the applicable law/regulation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Maximal Permitted Water Displacement
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximal permitted water displacement of a vessel or convoy according to the particular article/clause of the applicable law/regulation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Water Displacement Unit
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Units of measure for water displacement.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Cubic Metres
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A unit of volume equal to a cube one metre long on each side.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Tonnes
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Commonly referred to as the metric ton in Canada, the United Kingdom and the United States, is a non-SI metric unit of mass equal to 1,000 kilograms or one megagram (symbol: Mg). It is equivalent to approximately 2,204.6 pounds, 1.102 short tons (US) or 0.984 long tons (UK). Although not part of the SI, the tonne is accepted for use with SI units and prefixes by the International Committee for Weights and Measures.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Publication Reference
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Waterway or waterway section for which a juridical regulation with respect to the maximum permitted vessel dimensions exists.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Maximal Permitted Length
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximal permitted length of a vessel or convoy according to the particular article/clause of the applicable law/regulation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Maximal Permitted Speed
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximal permitted vessel speed according to the particular article/clause of the applicable law/regulation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Speed Reference
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicates the type of speed measurement.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Other
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Being the one or ones distinct from that or those first mentioned or implied.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Speed Over Ground
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The vessel's actual speed, determined by dividing the distance between successive fixes by the time between the fixes.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Speed Through Water
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: The vessel's actual speed, determined by subtracting the speed over ground by the current speed.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Mean Sea Level 1929
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A vertical control datum established for vertical control in the United States by the general adjustment of 1929.

When a berth is dedicated to waiting, but can be used for resting with permission of the operator of the infrastructure it is also a waiting berth.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Vessels carrying out transport operations involving certain flammable substances.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Two Blue Lights / Cones
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Vessels carrying out transport operations involving certain substances constituting health hazards.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Three Blue Lights / Cones
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Vessels carrying out transport operations involving certain explosives.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: No Blue Light / Cone
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Vessels carrying out transport operations for which no blue light or blue cone is required.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: One Red Light / Red Cone Top Down
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Russian inland waterway regulations: Vessels with one red light / red cone top down.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Current Velocity at High Water Level
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The rate of travel of a current at a high water level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Current Velocity at Low Water Level
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The rate of travel of a current at a low water level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Current Velocity at Mean Water Level
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The rate of travel of a current at a mean water level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Current Velocity at Other Water Level
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The rate of travel of a current at an other water level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Sounding Accuracy
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The best estimate of the accuracy of the sounding data.
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The maximum of the one-dimensional error. The error is assumed to be positive and negative. The plus/minus character shall not be encoded.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Elevation 1 of Surface (m)
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The maximum elevation of the bottom of a river within a depth contour and referred to a gravitational reference level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Elevation 2 of Surface (m)
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The minimum elevation of the bottom of a river within a depth contour and referred to a gravitational reference level.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Traffic Separation Scheme
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: International classification of traffic separation scheme.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: IMO Adopted
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A defined maritime traffic route that has been adopted as an IMO routeing measure.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Not IMO - Adopted
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: A defined Traffic Separation Scheme that has not been adopted as an IMO routing measure.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Address Delivery Point
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The delivery point (for example, street name and building number or post office box number) where a person or organization may be communicated with.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Address City
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The name of the city where a person or organization may be communicated with.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Address Administrative Area
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The administrative area component of an address.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Address Postal Code
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The postal code of the administrative area where a person or organization may be communicated with.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Address Country
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The name of the country where a person or organization may be communicated with.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Electronic Mail Address
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Identifies an email box to which email messages are delivered.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Administrative Division
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: A generic term for an administrative region within a country at a level below that of the sovereign state.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: City Name
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The name of a town or city.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Country Name
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: The name of a nation.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Delivery Point
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Details of where post can be delivered such as the apartment, name and/or number of a street, building or PO Box.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Postal code
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Known in various countries as a postcode, or ZIP code, the postal code is a series of letters and/or digits that identifies each postal delivery area.

S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:name: Category of Coverage
S100FC:S100_FC_SimpleAttribute.S100FC:definition: Indicator as to area of data coverage.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: Coverage Available
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: Continuous coverage of spatial objects is available within this area.

S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:label: No Coverage Available
S100FC:listedValue.S100FC:definition: An area containing no spatial objects.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Contact Address
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Direction or superscription of a letter, package, etc., specifying the name of the place to which it is directed, and optionally a contact person or organisation who should receive it.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Directional Character
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: A directional light is a light illuminating a sector of very narrow angle and intended to mark a direction to follow.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Feature Name
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Provides the name of an entity, defines the national language of the name, and provides the option to display the name at various system display settings.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Features Detected
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The uniform assessment of detected features.
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:remarks: A feature in this context is meant to be any object, whether man made or not, projecting above the sea floor, which may be a danger for surface navigation. (Refer IHO document S-44). Features detected does not describe if features were actually detected during a hydrographic survey, but whether the survey had the capacity to detect features.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Fixed Date Range
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: An active period of a single fixed event or occurrence, as the date range between discrete start and end dates.
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:remarks: Dates must be encoded in the format YYYYMMDD; using 4 digits for the calendar year (YYYY) and, optionally, 2 digits for the month (MM) (for example April = 04) and 2 digits for the day (DD). When no specific month and/or day is required/known, the values are replaced with dashes (-). The date range of a recurring event or occurrence must be encoded using periodicDateRange.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Frequency Pair
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: A pair of frequencies for transmitting and receiving radio signals. The shore station transmits and receives on the frequencies indicated.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Horizontal Clearance Fixed
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The horizontal clearance measured between two points for a fixed span.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Horizontal Clearance Open
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The horizontal clearance measured between two points for an opening span.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Horizontal Position Uncertainty
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The best estimate of the accuracy of a position.
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:remarks: The expected input is the maximum of the two-dimensional error. The error is assumed to be positive and negative.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Information
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Textual information about the feature. The information may be provided as a string of text or as a file name of a single external text file that contains the text.
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:remarks: At least one of the sub-attributes file reference or text must be populated.The sub-attribute file reference is generally used for long text strings or those that require formatting, however, there is no restriction on the type of text (except for lexical level) that can be held in files referenced by sub-attribute file reference.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Light Sector
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: A sector is the part of a circle between two straight lines drawn from the centre to the circumference.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Measured Distance Value
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The distance value indicated on a distance mark, or the distance between two measured distance marks.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Multiplicity of Features
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The number of features of identical character that exist as a co-located group.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Online Resource
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Information about online sources from which a resource or data can be obtained.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Orientation
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: (1) The angular distance measured from true north to the major axis of the feature. (2) In ECDIS, the mode in which information on the ECDIS is being presented. Typical modes include: north-up - as shown on a nautical chart, north is at the top of the display; Ships head-up - based on the actual heading of the ship, (e.g. Ships gyrocompass); course-up display - based on the course or route being taken.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Periodic Date Range
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The active period of a recurring event or occurrence.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Power Characteristics
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Characteristics of the power supply available

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Radar Wave Length
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The distance between two successive peaks (or other points of identical phase) on an electromagnetic wave in the radar band of the electromagnetic spectrum.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Rhythm of Light
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The sequence of times occupied by intervals of light/sound and eclipse/silence for all light characteristics or sound signals.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Schedule by Day of Week
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: The nature and timings of a daily schedule by days of the week.

S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:name: Sector Characteristics
S100FC:S100_FC_ComplexAttribute.S100FC:definition: Describes the characteristics of a light sector.
